rec.name: Exciting Content Elements (Image + Accordion Section, Variant 2)
rec.status: Built — launched (client feedback incorporated; source code delivered as zip)

what.text: A reusable Shopify section that pairs one large rounded image with a stack of up to 6 accordion cards. Each card has an icon, a bold heading, a subheading, and a round plus/close button. Clicking a card expands it to reveal rich-text content. The image on the left switches to match the open item (each item has its own thumbnail). Section, image and accordion styling are fully configurable in the theme editor.

why.text: The element condenses several benefits, features or USPs into a scannable list. Visitors self-select the information they care about (progressive disclosure), which lowers cognitive load and keeps the page short. The image that changes with the open item adds visual context and emotional appeal. Icons and short sublines let people scan benefits quickly, and expanding a card is a micro-commitment that deepens engagement.

how.text: Create the section file ed-cro-exciting-collapsible-image-content.liquid and paste in the provided code. It uses custom HTML, CSS, Liquid and vanilla JS (an <ed-collapsible-wrap> / <ed-collapsible> structure, no third-party plugins). Add 'Item' blocks (up to 6). For each block, set a thumbnail image, an icon (uploaded as an image or pasted as SVG, with custom width), a heading, a subheading and rich-text content. The first block or any block flagged 'open by default' is open at load. Single-open mode is on by default (opening one item closes the others). Then set the layout (image width %, gap, image position left/right, match content height), colors, corner radii, font sizes, plus-or-arrow toggle style, and desktop/mobile spacing. On mobile the layout stacks (image above the accordion) and icons can be hidden.

items: Image area: image per item block (JPG/PNG/WebP), thumbnail width %, thumbnail corner radius (desktop and mobile), image position left/right, match content height
Optional mobile hiding of the image (ticket requirement)
Optional overlay color and opacity for the image (ticket requirement, not confirmed in code)
Accordion items: 1–6 blocks, each with heading, subheading, rich-text content, 'open by default'
Icon per item: upload as image or paste SVG, icon width slider, 'Hide icons at mobile' toggle
Toggle button type: plus or arrow; icon color and icon background color
Collapsible card text color, background color, corner radius (desktop and mobile)
Typography: heading, subheading and content font size
Layout: gap between image and content, section background color, text color, optional custom max width
Section spacing: top/bottom/left/right padding, set separately for desktop and mobile
Single-open vs multi-open accordion (constant in JS: singleOpen)

dependencies.text: No apps or third-party JS. It needs a Shopify OS 2.0 theme with section-block support. The code references theme settings (settings.heading_color, settings.text_color, settings.background) and the 'Yuva' theme styling. Global CSS such as 'span.ed-icon-wrap img, svg' may affect other SVGs. Icon SVG paste-in and image upload are in the block settings. A product/lifestyle image is needed for each item.

items: Click-through to the next step (PDP, add-to-cart rate)
Conversion rate and bounce rate on pages with vs. without the section

Mobile view with client feedback: needs more spacing between icon and text, and the icon should be swappable by SVG

Theme editor mobile preview: 'Hide icons at mobile' toggle, mobile corner radii, colors, font sizes and mobile section spacing
